title: Colsdown 1.1.0 — The poster is the layout
tool: Repository-authored SVG geometry and embedded Geist text; Chromium PNG export
direction: User requested preserving the modular concept while restoring visual mechanisms, fitting type to its regions, and removing reuse and arrow navigation as separate pitches.
origin: Original editable SVG geometry, refined from the established Colsdown modular poster; no generated raster backdrop in this version.
description: Four integrated visual demonstrations: a resize divider, nested columns and stacks, a preset plus with layout thumbnails, and an editing caret beside rendered content.
